tvs.description-banner-inerial:
It's a pleasure to welcome you. My name is Aliona, I'm a permanent makeup artist at Studio LBar, and I've been working in this field for more than 5 years.

What does semi-permanent makeup mean to me? First and foremost, it's the chance to help women become more attractive, more feminine, more elegant and more self-confident. I personally understand how important a natural look is and how much beauty matters to every woman. That's exactly why, in my work, I avoid flashy colors and harsh, unnatural shapes with unpredictable, unattractive results.

In addition, thanks to strict sterility and hygiene standards, you'll get the semi-permanent makeup of your dreams in conditions that are completely safe for your health and your skin.

I'll be happy to meet you if you're visiting our studio for the first time. As an experienced PMU artist, I'll do everything I can to make you feel comfortable. First, we'll go over any questions you have, choose the right shade and draw the sketch. I guarantee the procedure will involve minimal discomfort, since I use a quality anesthetic for this purpose. After the procedure, I'll recommend how to care for your skin and book you in for a touch-up session.

I want to become the best semi-permanent makeup artist – the one you'll want to come back to again and again. As a PMU artist, I assure you that I'll do my utmost to give you a result that exceeds your expectations.
